page_title: LEI 0-2 FUL | Leicester v Fulham 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Tom Cairney (Fulham) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Wout Faes (Leicester). Michael Salisbury doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision. Fulham are awarded a mid-range free kick.

90+3' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sasa Lukic will be replaced by Issa Diop (Fulham).
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+1' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Joshua King (Fulham) replaces Harry Wilson.
88' Michael Salisbury shows the yellow card to Kasey McAteer (Leicester) for a heavy challenge.
88' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

87' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
86' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Victor Kristiansen (Leicester). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
84' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
81' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
80' Substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) has come on for Emile Smith Rowe.
79' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
76' Fulham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' 5:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leicester.

73' Leicester show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Leicester have been awarded a corner kick.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patson Daka (Leicester) will replace Stephy Mavididi.
71' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) replacing Jordan Ayew.
71' Raul Jimenez will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
70' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Harry Wilson puts a cross into the box and finds Adama Traore (Fulham), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Winks trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oliver Skipp (Leicester).
64' Ruud van Nistelrooy prepares a substitution. Bilal El Khannouss is replaced by Kasey McAteer (Leicester).
64' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

62' Harry Winks (Leicester) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
61' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Salisbury signals.
60' The ball goes out for a corner. Leicester can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Wonderful movement by Leicester. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
58' Harry Winks (Leicester) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his low, long-range blast aimed directly at the bottom of the net.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leicester comes to nothing.

56' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Bernd Leno is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Leicester.
55' The free kick is delivered by Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
54' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Sasa Lukic (Fulham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
53' Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.

52' Fulham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
51' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Sasa Lukic finds Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 0:1.
48' Fulham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for Fulham.
46' Marco Silva makes a switch. Adama Traore is coming on in place of Alex Iwobi (Fulham) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' The foul by Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Salisbury. A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
43' Harry Wilson (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
42' Fulham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.

42' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fulham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
39' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

38' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Jakub Stolarczyk scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.

36' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.

36' OFF THE BAR! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was! The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
34' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
32' Wout Faes (Leicester) is penalised for holding. Michael Salisbury signals a set piece.
31' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) picks up a long through ball, but Jakub Stolarczyk deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

29' The opposition can't get near Victor Kristiansen (Leicester), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
28' An attempted cross from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is cleared.
25' Fulham showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
23' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jakub Stolarczyk, who smothers the ball.

21' A clever short pass gives Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
19' Fulham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
17' 2:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

14' Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
11' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) inside the box.
8' Leicester take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
8' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Leicester will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leicester, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
6' The linesman signals that Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
4' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Jordan Ayew (Leicester), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
2' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Bernd Leno.
2' Leicester have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

2' Leicester show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Leicester.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Leicester will kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will officiate today.
